concerns.text: FR-005 (paired t-test/Wilcoxon) and SC-003 require statistical comparison of accuracy distributions. Task T024a/b covers this, but T024a depends on T019a/b (Lazy/Greedy runners) which are marked incomplete. Without T019a/b, T024a cannot execute, leaving FR-005 unimplemented.

FR-006 and SC-004 require Point-Biserial correlation and inflection point analysis. Task T025 covers correlation, but T027 (Threshold & Inflection Analysis) is marked incomplete. T027 depends on T024a/b and T025. If T027 is not implemented, the specific inflection point requirement in SC-004 is unmet.

FR-001 requires generating a synthetic noisy graph dataset. Task T011c generates this, but it depends on T011a-2 (schema validation) and T011b (noise injection). T011a-2 is marked incomplete. Without T011a-2, the noisy graph generation pipeline is broken, violating FR-001.

US-1 Independent Test requires outputting a CSV with `task_id`, `accuracy`, `nodes_visited`, and `inference_time_seconds`. Task T013 (Baseline Execution Runner) is marked incomplete. Without T013, the baseline results cannot be generated, failing the US-1 acceptance criteria.

US-2 requires executing Lazy and Greedy strategies and logging comparative metrics. Tasks T019a (Lazy Runner) and T019b (Greedy Runner) are marked incomplete. Without these, the system cannot execute the heuristics or log the required metrics, failing US-2.

Assumption about threshold justification requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping values {0.5, 0.7, 0.9}. Task T020 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked incomplete. Without T020, the robustness of the Lazy strategy across different confidence levels is unproven, violating the assumption.

US-4 requires handling edge cases (disconnected graphs, timeouts, degenerate inputs). Task T047 (End-to-End Robustness Test) is marked incomplete. While T044-T046 implement handlers, T047 is required to verify the full pipeline handles mixed edge cases without crashing, as per US-4 Independent Test.

Task T011a-3 (Record Raw Data Checksum) is marked incomplete. While T042 depends on it, the checksum recording is a critical step for Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and V (Versioning). Its absence leaves the artifact hash map incomplete.
